title: Global First Cooking AI Foundation Model Trained on Real Data Released, Cooking Robots Enter a New Era of Embodied Intelligence
excerpt: On August 23, Oak Deer Robotics officially launched the world's first multimodal cooking AI foundation model based on real kitchen data - "CookingMuse ChefStart
content_html:
On August 23, Oak Deer Robotics officially launched the world's first multimodal cooking AI foundation model based on real kitchen data - "CookingMuse ChefStart". This breakthrough marks a significant step forward for cooking artificial intelligence, moving from simple command execution to deep understanding and real-world application.

At the same time, the company also introduced two core hardware products: the 3K Visual AI Stir-frying Robot and the embodied cooking robot "XianChao Ark". The launch of these two new products indicates that its technical layout now fully covers the entire chain, from understanding cooking logic, perceiving and judging the environment and state, to finally embodied execution in the physical world.
